name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital and see up close how health care helps a community. Shifts are usually four hours a week. Your hours can count toward school service rules.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 15 and in high school before you start. You must turn in a current report card. Grades and attendance help decide if you can join.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The uniform shirt costs $25. You also buy tan pants and white tennis shoes.
deadline_text: No deadline or window is listed as of Nov 3, 2026. Call to ask about openings.
how_to_apply: Get an application at the Volunteer office or from the page. Turn it in with your report card. Then you have an interview. Questions: (661) 949-5105 or volunteers@avmc.org.
notes: You need two TB tests, which are free, and you must go to an orientation. The linked form is dated 2025.
